name: Shortcuts
description: Global user shortcuts for applications and commands
author: Asyar

walkthrough.title: Open anything with one key press
walkthrough.summary: Bind a global hotkey to a command you use constantly
walkthrough.body:
A global hotkey opens a specific command from anywhere on your desktop, without going through the search bar first. The commands you run ten times a day should never cost you a search.

## To complete the task

1. Run **Shortcuts**.
2. Bind a hotkey to the command you run most.
3. Use it from another app.

walkthrough.title: Give your favourites a two-letter name
walkthrough.summary: Set an alias so one command always wins the search
walkthrough.body:
An alias is a short word that jumps straight to one item — type it and that item is selected, every time, no matter what else matches.

Aliases are for the things you refuse to hunt for: `f` for file search, `cb` for clipboard history, `dw` for define word.

## To complete the task

Select any item in the search results, open the action panel, and give it an alias.
